name: treinos-esportivos-api
description: API REST de treinos esportivos com cálculo de carga e relatório semanal de risco de sobrecarga (Express + Sequelize + MySQL)

scripts.db:setup: npm run db:create && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:reset: sequelize-cli db:seed:undo:all && sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
